To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
environmental management practices in tourism SMEs in Mallorca have evolved over the last five years towards social innovation, which can be regarded as the most sustainable model of sustainability.
“Environmental initiatives in Mallorca tourism companies, with special consideration for those involving partnerships and other parties in the value chain, are moving towards social innovation”.
environmental initiatives involving partnerships and synergism with other parties (e.g. other companies, academic ones) in the industry are a key element of social innovation in the tourism industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of SI in the tourism industry, the importance of partnerships and synergies in the development of SI, the role of the local context in SI and the role of SI as a tool for the development of sustainability.
the role of social innovation in the development of environmental management practices in tourism companies in the island of Mallorca.
the development of SI approaches in the hospitality sector in Mallorca and the implications for sustainability and the environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

environmental best practice in tourism companies in the island of Mallorca is not only a way to improve environmental performance but also a way to develop SI approaches in the industry and a way to develop a more sustainable tourism industry.
the environmental management best practices are a social innovation process that can be considered as a model for sustainability.
the study shows that SI is a key element for the development of sustainability within the industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cases of social innovation in Mallorca are a good example for other destinations to follow in their efforts towards sustainable tourism.
the cases of environmental management in the tourism sector in Mallorca can be regarded as an example of social innovation.
the tourism companies in Mallorcan are increasingly committed to sustainability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
environmental management is a key element in a SI approach and that the tourism industry can be a good example of this.
the tourism industry is a fertile ground for SI and that the development of SI in tourism can be enhanced if the industry embraces a systemic approach to sustainability.
environmental best practices in tourism companies can lead to a more sustainable industry and, therefore, can contribute to a better future for all.
